# TrulyPlaced

> TrulyPlaced is a done-for-you job application service. A career specialist rewrites your resume and sends 10–15 checked applications a business day on your behalf (150, 300 or 600 per plan), tailoring each one. Every role is checked for fit and eligibility before it is sent, applications go out from a secure browser in the US in your name, and you track every application, with proof of each submission, and every interview in a client portal. For roles in the US, UK, Canada and Australia. Run by RepoReserve Technologies Private Limited (India).

## Service

- [Home](https://trulyplaced.com/): how it works, what a sprint looks like, members' offers, pricing and FAQ
- Pricing: plans are paid once for a volume of checked applications (150, 300 or 600) at $299, $449 or $699, with no subscription; each price includes a one-time $100 onboarding fee
- [Cancellation & Refund Policy](https://trulyplaced.com/refunds.html): unused applications are refunded pro-rata
- [Contact](https://trulyplaced.com/contact.html): hello@trulyplaced.com, WhatsApp, business details

## Free tools

- [Resume X-Ray (free ATS resume checker)](https://trulyplaced.com/ats-check.html): see what an applicant tracking system extracts from your resume and what it drops, get every bullet graded, and check your match against a job. Runs in the browser; the resume never leaves the device.
